howToDL: How to download Desmos App on Ledger?
modalTitle:
How to download Desmos 
App on Ledger?
modalDescription:
1. Visit Ledger Live desktop application.

2. You can search “Desmos” in the App catalog in the Ledger Live Manager. 

3. After the installation is done, you will see the Desmos Ledger app on your Ledger device.
